import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesPrincipalization

/-! # Principal divisor-module ranges

The multiplication equivalence for divisor modules identifies the sections of
`O(-div(q))` with the regular sections multiplied by a rational unit `q`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule divisorSectionsModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- On a nonempty open, sections of the principal divisor module `O(-div(q))`
are exactly regular functions multiplied by the rational unit `q`.

The equality is stated on carriers because `divisorSections` is a `K`-submodule,
whereas the regular-function span is naturally a `Γ(X,U)`-submodule. -/
theorem divisorSections_neg_divOf_eq_span (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (q : X.functionFieldˣ) :
    (divisorSections K (- divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) U : Set X.functionField) =
      (Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {(q : X.functionField)} : Set X.functionField) := by
  have hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty := U.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance
  let hq : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz ((0 : X.CurveDivisor) - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) =
        coeffAt hz (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) := by
    intro z hz hzU
    rw [zero_sub]
  let e := divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K 0
    (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) q U hq
  let z0 := divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K U
  ext a
  constructor
  · intro ha
    let t : Γ(divisorModules K (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q), U) := ⟨a, ha⟩
    let s : Γ(divisorModules K (0 : X.CurveDivisor), U) := e.symm t
    let r : Γ(X, U) := z0 s
    have hs : e s = t := e.apply_symm_apply t
    have hval := divisorVal_divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K 0
      (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) q hU hq s
    have hr := germ_divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K hU s
    have haeq : a = (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X)
        (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom r * (q : X.functionField) := by
      change divisorVal K t = _
      rw [← hs, hval, ← hr]
      exact mul_comm _ _
    rw [haeq]
    change _ ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {(q : X.functionField)}
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨r, rfl⟩
  · intro ha
    rcases Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp ha with ⟨r, hr⟩
    rw [← hr]
    let sr : Γ(divisorModules K (0 : X.CurveDivisor), U) := z0.symm r
    let t := e sr
    have hval := divisorVal_divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K 0
      (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) q hU hq sr
    have hr' := germ_divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K hU sr
    have hta : divisorVal K t =
        (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X)
          (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom r * (q : X.functionField) := by
      rw [hval, ← hr']
      change (q : X.functionField) *
        (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X)
          (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom (z0 (z0.symm r)) = _
      rw [z0.apply_symm_apply, mul_comm]
    change (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X)
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom r * (q : X.functionField) ∈ _
    rw [← hta]
    exact divisorVal_mem K t

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
